kaa.mistake_note_md: Tuwrı qosıwshı ańlatpada belgini ózgertpey qaldırıw yamasa bólimde tamırlar ayırmasın $\sqrt{m-n}$ dep alıw.

en.solution_md: Multiply numerator and denominator by the conjugate $\sqrt{14}-\sqrt{13}$ (difference of squares): $\frac{3\left(\sqrt{14}-\sqrt{13}\right)}{14-13}=\frac{3\left(\sqrt{14}-\sqrt{13}\right)}{1}=3\sqrt{14}-3\sqrt{13}$.
en.mistake_note_md: Not changing the sign in the conjugate, or treating the difference of roots as $\sqrt{m-n}$.
